title: Kristal-Catho — doctrine and evidence
scope_context: Catholic/Christian semantic corpus, official-source provenance, dossiers and an independent persons/recognitions registry.
notes: P279 Catholicism (Q1841) explores doctrinal descendants, not an authoritative Church classification.
P361 Catholic Church (Q9592) explores part-of relationships, not doctrinal authority.
P140 religion/worldview is a declared Wikidata attribute; it cannot prove institutional membership, beliefs or merit.
Respect the official pontiff/doctor and other curated lists already present in the Kristal; no automatic canon writes.

passes.title: 01 · Doctrinal concepts · P279 (recommended)
passes.intent: Explore Catholicism Q1841 subclasses to form a reviewable topical vocabulary, not a doctrinal judgment.
passes.risk: Many essential topics and historical positions will not be descendants of Catholicism via P279.

passes.title: 02 · Church-related parts · P361
passes.intent: Inspect items marked as part of Catholic Church Q9592. Separately review affiliation and jurisdiction.
passes.risk: Part-of is not ecclesial authority or recognition; avoid promoting Wikidata claims directly.

passes.title: 03 · Religion claims · P140 (advanced)
passes.intent: Inventory items whose P140 refers to Catholic Church Q9592; audit potential sources rather than treating as believers or saints.
passes.risk: Very broad/noisy. Limit 25,000 QIDs for first pass; a limit_reached run is incomplete and must be resumed with increased/unlimited cap for final inventory.
